decision: Keep the current Japanese candidate implementation in-process, but place it behind a versioned transport-neutral provider port. LSP is an optional future adapter, not the core boundary.

ownership.provider: portable Japanese candidate discovery and provider-local rank
ownership.candidate_core: cross-source dedupe, final rank, Vim display decoration
ownership.commit: exact raw span validation and sole buffer write

hardening: adapter-internal E117 preserved instead of misreported as adapter absence
alias filter_text uses the reachable alias

rejected_alternatives.reason: adds JSON-RPC, process lifecycle, document sync, cancellation and packaging while selected state, ghost and commit remain editor-owned
would couple dictionary discovery to Vim UI and make a second editor require a rewrite

rejected_alternatives.alternative: LSP CompletionItem as core item type
rejected_alternatives.reason: couples domain and ranking semantics to one transport protocol

lsp_trigger: a concrete second editor client such as Helix
a requirement to share one provider process across editors
dictionary indexing or memory must be isolated from the editor process
